verdict.rationale: Pika's own Smart Resize app reframes photos and videos for different aspect ratios, and its Upscale app increases video resolution, so a marketer can adapt clips for different channels inside Pika without external re-encoding. The evidence never names 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 as native generation options and never states a 1080p-or-above video output; the 4K claim (Seedream 5) covers images only. Missing for 10: explicit documented aspect-ratio presets (16:9/9:16/1:1) at generation time, a stated 1080p+ video output resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration of output specs.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding

citations.quote: Resize photos and videos for different aspect ratios with Pika Smart Resize. Use AI to reframe the subject and adapt the layout for each format.
